cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Call It a Fair Win
cards.instruction: Get them to recognize the result as deserved rather than accidental, gifted, or manipulated.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. You don't think they let me win the race, do you?

mechanism: Copy a rival's slowdown as finishing technique, then reinterpret a rescue gesture as a deserved athletic win.
confusable: Not simply an arrogant winner: B2/B4 must reveal the actual meanings of the behavior A copied or misread.
comparison: Private dispute about sporting conduct rather than editing a public quiz caption.
seedUse: Retains race win/others slowing and merit claim; calf injury and misunderstood wave replace knot preparation.
